title: Grade 12 MUSIC AND DANCE — General Assessment #3

pages.quiz:
MUSIC AND DANCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Remove the need for rules

2. Best practice when working on Western Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Western Instruments.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Western Instruments.
   C. Damage equipment used for Western Instruments.
   D. Practise Western Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Setting Text to Music: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Setting Text to Music.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Setting Text to Music.
   C. Damage equipment used for Setting Text to Music.
   D. Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software.: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software..
   B. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software..
   C. Practise Music Notation Software. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software..

5. Best practice when working on Contemporary Songs from Kenya: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Contemporary Songs from Kenya.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Contemporary Songs from Kenya.
   C. Damage equipment used for Contemporary Songs from Kenya.
   D. Practise Contemporary Songs from Kenya with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Green, orange, and purple

7. Best practice when working on Instrumental Transpositions: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Instrumental Transpositions.
   B. Damage equipment used for Instrumental Transpositions.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Instrumental Transpositions.
   D. Practise Instrumental Transpositions with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Four-Part Harmony: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Four-Part Harmony.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Four-Part Harmony.
   C. Practise Four-Part Harmony with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Four-Part Harmony.

9. Best practice when working on Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble.
   C. Practise Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble.

10. Best practice when working on Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World.
   B. Damage equipment used for Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World.
   D. Practise Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the costume
   D. Only the volume

12. Best practice when working on Kenyan Contemporary Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Contemporary Songs.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Contemporary Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Contemporary Songs.
   D. Practise Kenyan Contemporary Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Instrumental Transpositions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Setting Text to Music and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Four-Part Harmony and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. D — Practise Western Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. C — Practise Music Notation Software. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. A — Red, blue, and yellow

8. C — Practise Four-Part Harmony with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. C — Practise Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. D — Practise Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. B — The speed of the music

12. D — Practise Kenyan Contemporary Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

16. (4 marks)
